For a **main UK account** (where your salary lands and bills are paid), **Starling Bank** is the most reliable and complete choice. 

While Chase and Revolut have strong features, both have gaps that make them frustrating to use as your *sole* bank account. 

Here is how the three compare across key categories:

---

### Comparison Breakdown

| Feature | Starling Bank | Chase UK | Revolut |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **UK Banking Licence & FSCS** | Full UK Bank (FSCS covered) | Full UK Bank (J.P. Morgan, FSCS covered) | UK Bank Licence (FSCS rolling out) |
| **Current Account Switch Service (CASS)** |  Yes | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Paying in Cheques** |  Yes (in-app photo up to £1,000) | ❌ No | ❌ No |
| **Cash Deposits** |  Post Office (Free up to £1,000/yr) | Limited (PayPoint) | Limited (PayPoint / fees apply) |
| **Joint Accounts** |  Yes | ❌ No |  Yes |
| **Overdraft Available** |  Yes (subject to status) | ❌ No | ❌ Very limited / rolling out |
| **Everyday Perks / Cashback** | ❌ Modest |  **1% cashback** on debit spending (up to £15/mo) | Perks tied to paid monthly subscriptions |
| **Spending Abroad** |  Fee-free (Mastercard rate, no weekend fee) |  Fee-free (Mastercard rate) |  Great weekday FX rates, but weekend markups & monthly limits on free plan |
| **Desktop Web Access** |  Yes | ❌ App-only |  Yes |

---

### Detailed Pros and Cons

#### 1. Starling Bank — **Best for a Main Account**
* **Why it wins:** It functions like a modern, frictionless version of a traditional high-street bank. You get a full banking licence, joint accounts, overdrafts, and desktop web access (lifesaver if you lose your phone).
* **Cash & Cheques:** If an employer or family member gives you a cheque, you can photograph and clear it in the app. If you need to deposit cash, you can do it over the counter at any UK Post Office.
* **Customer Support:** Starling consistently scores at the top of independent UK customer satisfaction surveys and offers 24/7 UK-based support.
* **Drawback:** It does not offer aggressive cashback on debit card spending.

#### 2. Chase UK — **Best for Spending Perks & Savings**
* **Why it’s great:** It offers 1% cashback on eligible debit card spending, a high-yield round-up savings account, and competitive linked savings.
* **Why it struggles as a main account:**
  * **No joint accounts:** If you manage finances with a partner, Chase cannot be your shared bills hub.
  * **No cheques:** You cannot deposit a cheque.
